WITH groups AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_instownpct
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
), baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS avg_instownpct
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
)
SELECT AVG(g.avg_instownpct) AS mean_group_average,
       AVG(g.avg_instownpct - b.avg_instownpct) AS mean_excess_over_baseline
FROM groups AS g
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
WHERE g.avg_instownpct > b.avg_instownpct;
